reports.headline: Buzzing in the Walls of the Old House
reports.body: The old house {dir} of the village {dist} has started to buzz, the whole building, like a hive. {name} looked through a window and saw the ceiling of one room covered in something pale and wet, and things moving inside it.

reports.headline: Flies Thick as Smoke Around the Old House
reports.body: There are flies around the old house {dir} of here {dist}, so many that from the road it looks like the place is smoking. {name} swears some of them had faces. The flies leave the village alone, for now.

reports.headline: Egg Sacs Found in the Old House
reports.body: {name} went into the old house {dir} of the village {dist} to board it up and came out white. {name} says there was a thing in the back room dragging an egg sac as big as itself, and the eggs had little heads in them.
